concerns.text: The file `contracts/study.schema.yaml` contradicts `contracts/cleaned_study.schema.yaml` and `data-model.md`. It uses different field names (e.g., `n_intervention` vs `n_treatment`, `pre_mean_int` vs `mean_treatment`) and is not referenced in the plan or spec. This creates an ambiguous source of truth for the data contract.
Quickstart references `data/raw/studies.json` as the input for the cleaner, whereas `plan.md` (Task 5) designates `data/raw/verified_snapshot_2026.json` as the canonical baseline for reproducibility.
